tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo don bdun cu'i rnam bshad ngo mtshar 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba bzhugs pa dge/ mkha' mnyam rigs can gsum gyi byang chub gsum/ /tshe gsum bskal pa brgya dang grangs med gsum/ /dus gsum nyid la 'grub pa'i lam rim gsum/ /gsal mdzad rgyal ba gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes mchod par brjod nas/ bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo 'chad byed don bdun cu 'chad par byed pa la/ gang zhig spyad cing nyams su blangs pas lus can kun gyi sgrib pa zad pa'i thabs su gyur pa de/ dam pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ /sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang / sgrib kun sel byed dam pa'i chos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na/ lung gi dam pa'i chos dang / rtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos gnyis su yod de/ mdzod las/ /ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung gi dam pa'i chos la dbye na/ bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su yod de/ lha'i bu rab gnas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus/ /legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel ba/ /de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni/ /'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po bka' la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spobs pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ bka'i mtshan nyid yin/ spobs pa bzhi ni/ brjod bya don dang ldan pa/ rjod byed ngag tshig dri ma med pa/ byed las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs spong ba/ 'bras bu zhi ba'i phan yon ston pa dang bzhi la byed de/ de skad du yang rgyud bla ma las/ /gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing /

/khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsungs/ /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bka' de la bdag rkyen gyi sgo nas dbye na/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka'/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' dang gsum du yod/ dang po zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' ni/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' la dbye na/ skus byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka'/ gsung gis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka'/ thugs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' dang gsum du yod/ skus byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' ni/ laṅkar gshegs pa'i mdo lta bu la byed/ gsung gis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' ni/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa sel ba'i mdo lta bu la byed/ thugs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' la dbye na/ thugs thugs rje chen pos byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka'/ thugs bden pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka'/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' dang gsum du yod/ thugs thugs rje chen pos byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' ni/ phal po che'i mdo lta bu la byed/ thugs bden pa'i stobs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus nam mkha' dang ljon shing sogs las byung ba'i chos kyi sgra lta bu la byed/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i bka' ni/ shes rab snying po'i mdo lta bu la byed/ gsum pa rjes su gnang ba'i bka' ni/ mgor 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes pa dang / mjug tu mthun 'gyur yi rang bsgom pa'i mdo lta bu la byed do/ /yang bka' de la sde tshan gyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dul ba'i sde snod/ mdo sde'i sde snod/ mngon pa'i sde snod dang gsum du yod/ 'dul ba'i sde snod la mtshan nyid ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab te/

'dul ba'i sde snod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi lta bu la byed/ mdo sde'i sde snod la mtshan nyid ni/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ mdo sde'i sde snod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ mdo sde dran pa nyer gzhag lta bu la byed/ mngon pa'i sde snod la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ theg pa chen po'i chos mngon pa dang / theg pa chung ngu'i chos mngon pa gnyis su yod/ theg pa chen po'i chos mngon pa ni/ mngon pa'i mdo stong phrag brgya pa lta bu la byed/ theg pa chung ngu'i chos mngon pa la/ mngon pa sde bdun du yod/ mngon pa sde bdun ni/ ji skad du/ ye shes la 'jug ka ta'i bus/ /rab tu byed par dbyig shes kyis/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /chos kyi rnam grangs shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mau'u 'gal bus/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs sus po ches/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ yang bka' de la rjod byed kyi sgo nas dbye na/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis su yod/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ni/ ji skad du/ /mdo sde dbyangs snyad lung du bstan/ /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /rmad byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang bka' de la dus kyi sgo nas dbye na/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ ston pas dus dang por gsung shing /

'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ ston pas dus bar du gsungs shing rnam thar sgo gsum brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo lta bu la byed/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ ston pas dus tha mar gsungs shing / ngo bo nyid med pa gsum brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab de/ bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa bstan bcos la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ 'chos skyob kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i ngag rnam dag de/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ ji skad du/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro'i srid las skyob byed gang yin la/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te/ /gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos de la byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'thor ba sdud par byed pa'i bstan bcos/ 'khrugs pa go rims sdebs pa'i bstan bcos/ mdo don rgya chen po ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum du yod/ dang po 'thor ba sdud par byed pa'i bstan bcos ni/ bslab pa kun las btus pa lta bu la byed/ 'khrugs pa go rims sdebs pa'i bstan bcos ni/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba lta bu la byed/ mdo don rgya chen po ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan lta bu la byed/ yang bstan bcos de la dgos pa'i sgo nas dbye na don dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos/

sgrub pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos/ sdug bsngal spong ba'i bstan bcos dang gsum du yod de/ ji skad du/ bsdu ba las/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len pa/ /ngan g.yo brtse bral sdug bsngal spong / /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang bstan bcos de la bka'i dgongs 'grel gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bka' spyi'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos dang / bka' so so'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ dang po la brjod bya dag par byed pa'i bstan bcos dang / rjod byed gtan la 'bebs par byed pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ sgra'i bstan bcos kā la pa dang / tsaṇḍa pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ tshad ma sde bdun lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa bka' so so'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos la dbye na/ bka' dang po'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos/ bka' bar pa'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos/ bka' tha ma'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos dang gsum du yod/ dang po la grub mtha'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos dang / spyod pa'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ grub mtha'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos ni/ mngon pa mdzod lta bu la byed/ spyod pa'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos ni/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba lta bu la byed/ bka' bar pa'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos la dbye na/ spyod pa'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos dang / lta ba'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ spyod pa'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos ni/ bslab pa kun las btus lta bu la byed/ lta ba'i cha gtso bor ston pa'i bstan bcos la dbye na/ dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa gsal par byed pa'i bstan bcos dang /

sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa gsal ba par byed pa'i bstan bcos ni/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug lta bu la byed/ dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug ni/ rtsa ba shes rab/ rigs pa drug cu pa/ stong nyid bdun cu pa/ rtsod pa zlog pa/ zhib mo rnam 'thag tha snyad grub pa dang drug la byed/ sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan lta bu la byed do/ /bka' tha ma'i dgongs pa 'grel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ni/ byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shu yod pa las/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ma gtogs pa rnams la byed/ chos sde nyi shu ni/ rtsa ba rje btsun byams pas mdzad pa dang / 'grel pa thogs med sku mched kyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rtsa ba rje btsun byams pas mdzad pa ni/ byams pa'i chos lnga la byed/ byams pa'i chos lnga ni/ mdo sde rgyan/ mngon rtogs rgyan/ rgyud bla ma/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed/ chos nyid rnam 'byed dang lnga la byed/ 'grel pa thogs med sku mched kyis mdzad pa la/ thogs med kyis mdzad pa dang / dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ thogs med kyis mdzad pa la/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga dang / bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sdom rnam pa gnyis/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sa sde lnga ni/ sa'i dngos gzhi bsdu ba/ gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba/ gzhi bsdu ba/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par bshad pa 'i sgo bsdu ba dang lnga la byed/ bsdus pa'i bstan bcos sdom rnam pa gnyis ni/ theg pa thun mong ba'i sdom mngon pa kun las btus dang / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom theg bsdus lta bu la byed do/ /dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa la/ rab tu byed pa sde brgyad yod/ rab tu byed pa sde brgyad ni/ rang rkang du mdzad pa lnga dang / gzhan 'grel du mdzad pa gsum dang brgyad la byed/

rang rkang du mdzad pa lnga ni/ nyi shu pa'i rab tu byed pa/ sum cu pa'i rab tu byed pa/ las grub pa'i rab tu byed pa/ phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa/ rnam bshad rigs pa dang lnga la byed/ gzhan 'grel du mdzad pa gsum ni/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ dbus mtha'i 'grel pa/ rten 'brel mdo 'grel dang gsum la byed do/ /de rnams kyi nang nas mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa 'chad par byed pa la/ gus pas 'jug pa'i yan lag mchod brjod/ gzhan bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel/ mdo dang bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang sras 'phags pa la phan 'dogs byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ mchod yum tsam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ zag med kyi phung po skyed byed kyi yum dang / bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ zag med kyi phung po gsar du skrun byed kyi mkhyen pa de/ zag med kyi phung po skyed byed kyi yum gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ theg pa chen po'i chos la mos pa/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab/ bsam gtan/ brtse ba snying rje chen po dang bzhir yod/ de yang theg pa chen po'i chos la mos pa ni/ pha'i sa bon dang chos mtshungs/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ni/ skyed par byed pa'i ma dang chos mtshungs/ bsam gtan ni bde ba'i mngal dang chos mtshungs/ brtse ba snying rje chen po ni skyes zin gso bar byed pa'i ma ma dang chos mtshungs pa yin te/ je skad du/ rgyud bla ma las/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos bskyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/

mtshan nyid ni/ rang sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don bsgrub nus kyi mkhyen pa de'o/ /de la dbye na mchod yum gzhi shes/ mchod yum lam shes/ mchod yum rnam mkhyen dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang sras theg dman 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub nus kyi mkhyen pa de mchod yum gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de yang theg dman gyi gzhi shes ni/ rang sras theg dman 'phags pa'i bzhed don dngos su sgrub par byed/ byang sems 'phags pa'i gzhi shes ni/ theg dman 'phags pa'i bzhed don brgyud nas bsgrub par byed do/ /theg dman 'phags pa'i bzhed don ni/ nyer zhi gnyis la byed/ nyer zhi gnyis ni/ dman pa'i lhag bcas myang 'das dang / lhag med myang 'das gnyis la byed/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ma lus par spongs shing / nyon mongs pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa'i dman pa'i so sor brtags 'gog de/ dman pa'i lhag bcas myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sku tshe'i 'du byed ma btang ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi so sor brtags 'gog lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung ma lus par spongs shing / nyon mongs pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyi phung po lhag ma dang bral ba'i dman pa'i so sor brtags 'gog de lhag med myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi so sor brtags 'gog lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa mchod yum lam shes la mtshan nyid ni rang sras byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don bsgrub nus kyi mkhyen pa de/ mchod yum lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de yang dbyings kyi lam shes kyis ni rang sras byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don dngos su sgrub par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i lam shes kyis ni/

byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don brgyud nas sgrub par byed do/ /byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don ni/ gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba blangs pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten gyi don bsgrub par mdzad pa'o/ /gsum pa mchod yum rnam mkhyen la mtshan nyid ni/ rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don bsgrub nus kyi mkhyen pa de'o/ /de yang rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pas ni/ rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don dngos su sgrub par byed/ rnam mkhyen rjes mthun pas ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don brgyud nas sgrub par byed do/ /sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don ni/ gzhan don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin la/ de la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis mtshan nyid ni/ ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos gang zhig rang gi mi mthun phyogs gcod byed de/ chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor dang lung gi chos 'khor gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang ston byed du gyur pa'i lung gi chos shes rab gsum gyis goms par byas pa las byung ba'i rnam byang gi bden pa de/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ 'gog bden dang lam bden gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ thar pa rgyu 'bras gang rung brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs su snang ba'i rnam rig de/ lung gi chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su yod/ bka' la drang nges kyi sgo nas dbye na/ drang don kyi mdo dang / nges don gyi mdo gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ ched du bya ba'i gdul bya theg pa thun mong pa'i rigs can la dgos pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsogs pa'i phyir du bstan bya'i gtso bo kun rdzob bden pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo de/

drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ drang don gyi drang don gyi mdo dang / drang don gyi nges don gyi mdo gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ drang don gyi mdo gang zhig sgra ji bzhin du khas blangs du mi rung ba de/ drang don gyi drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing / /zhes sogs kyi mdo lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ drang don gyi mdo gang zhig sgra ji bzhin du khas blangs du rung ba de/ drang don gyi nges don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ tshogs bsogs pa las bde ba 'byung / zhes sogs kyi mdo lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa nges don kyi mdo la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ ched du bya ba'i gdul bya theg pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs can la dgos pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsogs pa'i phyir du bstan bya'i gtso bo don dam bden pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo de/ nges don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ nges don gyi drang don gyi mdo dang / nges don gyis nges don gyi mdo gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ nges don gyi mdo gang zhig sgra ji bzhin du khas blangs du mi rung ba de/ nges don gyi drang don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sher phyin kyi mdo lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ nges don gyi mdo gang zhig sgra ji bzhin du khas blangs du rung ba de/ nges don gyi nges don gyi mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel lta bu'o/ /yang bka' la dbye na/ dgongs pa can gyi mdo dang / ldem dgongs kyi mdo gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dgongs gzhi gtso bor ston pa'i mdo de/ dgongs pa can gyis mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa/ dus gzhan la dgongs pa/ don gzhan la dgongs pa/ gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa dang bzhi ru yod/

gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ dgongs pa gtso bor ston pa'i mdo de/ ldem dgongs kyi mdo'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ gzhug pa ldem por dgongs pa/ gnyen po ldem por dgongs pa/ bsgyur ba ldem por dgongs pa/ mtshan nyin ldem por dgongs pa dang bzhir yod do/ /gnyis pa gzhan bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel bshad pa la/ dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi dang / bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi gnyis/ dang po dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi ni/ dgos 'brel ngag gi brjod bya/ dgos pa/ nying dgos/ 'brel pa dang bzhi la byed/ dgos 'brel ngag gi brjod bya ni/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi la byed/ dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos pa ni/ bstan bcos 'di brtsams pa'i dgos pa yod dam snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom skyes pa la byed/ dgos 'brel ngag gi nying dgos ni/ don 'gyur gyi the tshom la brten nas bstan bcos 'di la thos bsam gyis zhugs pa la byed/ dgos 'brel ngag gi 'brel pa ni/ dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos gsum dang / de ston byed kyi bstan bcos gnyis thabs thabs byung gi tshul gyis 'brel ba la byed do/ /bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi ni/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i brjod bya/ dgos pa/ nying dgos/ 'brel ba dang bzhi la byed/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i brjod bya ni/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad la byed/ dgos pa ni/ mdo don bde blag tu rtogs pa la byed/ nying dgos ni/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po ma lus par mngon sum du rtogs pa la byed/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i 'brel pa ni/ bstan bcos mngon rtogs rgyan dang / de'i brjod bya mngon par rtogs pa brgyad po thabs thabs byung gi tshul gyis 'brel ba la byed do/

/gsum pa mdo dang bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la/ dbye gzhi sher phyin bshad pa dang / dbye ngo mngon par rtogs pa brgyad yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gnyis med kyi ye shes gang zhig srid zhi gnyis kyi pha rol tu phyin zin pa'am/ der phyin bya dang phyin byed gang rung de/ sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ gzhung sher phyin/ lam sher phyin/ rang bzhin sher phyin/ 'bras bu sher phyin dang bzhir yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rang bzhin sher phyin brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs su snang ba'i rnam rig de/ gzhung sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bka' brgyad stong pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang bzhin sher phyin mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa de/ lam sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin de la dbye na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam dang gsum du yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi de kho na nyid de/ rang bzhin sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ slob pa'i rang bzhin sher phyin dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rang bzhin sher phyin gnyis su yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid ni/ srid zhi gnyis kyi pha rol tu phyin zin pa de/ 'bras bu sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa dbye ngo mngon par rtogs pa brgyad yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa la/ mkhyen gsum yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa/ sbyor bzhi yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa/ chos sku yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ 'bras bu thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa/ rgyu thun mongs ma yin pa'i lam shes yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa/

rgyu dang rgyu min gyi rab dbye gzhi shes yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ mtshon bya rnam mkhyen bshad pa dang / de mtshon byed kyi chos bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ bden gnyis kyi rnam pa ma lus pa thugs su chud pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa de/ rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ chos nyid dri ma mtha' dag zhi ba mthar thug pa'i ye shes de/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i 'gog bden lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ shes bya kun la blo gros thogs med du rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rgyu 'bras kyi gtso bo mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen dang / shes bya'i rnam pa ma lus par mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ chos rnams kyi rnam gzhag dag tshad ma gsum mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes lta bu la byed/ gsum pa sa mtshams ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod do/ /gnyis pa de mtshon byed kyi chos bshad pa la/ bsam pa sems bskyed pa dang / sbyor ba sgrub pa la 'jug pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ ched du bya ba sems can gyi don dang / dmigs pa byang chub la dmigs pa'i mkhyen pa de/ theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ theg chen kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / don dam sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig

gtso bor gzhan don gyi sku la dmigs pa'i mkhyen pa de/ theg chen kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dpe'i sgo nas dbye na/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed nas/ sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed gyi bar nyer gnyis su yod/ grogs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ 'dun pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed nas/ chos sku dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed kyi bar nyer gnyis su yod/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed/ rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi ru yod/ dang po ni/ tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ ma dag sa bdun gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ dag pa sa gsum gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sems bskyed lta bu la byed do/ /de skad du yang / mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ theg chen kun rdzob sems bskyed la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ ched du bya ba sems can gyi don dang / dngos kyi dmigs pa rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de smon pa sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi smon pa sems bskyed lta bu la byed/ sa mtshams ni/ lam ma zhugs nas/ sa bcu pa'i bar na yod/ 'jug pa sems bskyed la mtshan nyid ni/ ched du bya ba rdzogs byang gi phyir du dngos kyi dmigs pa gzhan don la dmigs pa'i bslab pa yang dag par blangs nas bsrungs ba'i sems pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de'o/

/mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'jug pa sems bskyed lta bu la byed/ sa mtshams ni/ lam ma zhugs nas/ sa bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ gnyis pa don dam sems bskyed la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ dam pa gsum gyis zin pa'i sems bskyed de'o/ /dam pa gsum ni sgrub pa dam pa/ rtogs pa dam pa/ yongs 'dzin dam pa dang gsum la byed de/ de skad du yang / mdo sde rgyan las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes bya/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtogs ye shes ni/ /skyes phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na/ theg chen slob pa'i don dam sems bskyed dang / mi slob pa'i don dam sems bskyed gnyis su yod/ sa mtshams ni/ theg pa chen po'i mthong lam nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba bsgrub pa la 'jug pa'i tshul la/ sgrub pa'i thabs ston pa'i gdams ngag thob bya sgrub pa'i 'bras bu/ 'jug bya sgrub pa'i yan lag gi chos bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la spyir bshad pa dang / 'dir bstan gdams ngag bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ byang chub thob pa'i thabs ston pa'i ngag de/ gdams ngag tsam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na theg chen gyi gdams ngag dang / theg dman gyi gdams ngag gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can la gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i thabs ston pa'i ngag de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen gyi sde snod lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ gdul bya theg dman gyi rigs can la gtso bor thar pa thob pa'i thabs ston pa'i ngag de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ theg dman gyi sde snod lta bu la byed/ 'dir nyan pa po'i sa mtshams ni/ lam la zhugs nas/ sa bcu pa'i bar na yod la/ 'chad pa po'i sa mtshams kyang ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nas/

sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa 'dir bstan gdams ngag bye brag tu bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i thabs ston pa'i ngag de/ 'dir bstan gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dgos pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ gdam pa'i gdams ngag dang / rjes bstan gyi gdams ngag gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ sngar yod kyi yon tan mi nyams pa'i phyir du 'doms pa'i ngag de'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sngar ma thob pa'i yon tan thob phyir du 'doms pa'i ngag de'o/ /de la yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag dmigs yul bden pa bzhi la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs sel byed brtson 'grus gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag sgrub pa'i yon tan spyan dang mngon shes la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu mthong sgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag dang bcur yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang bden gnyis bshad pa gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' zhing / yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sgrub pa nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i ngag de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ yul bden pa gnyis bshad pa la/ don dam bden pa dang kun rdzob bden pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong ba yang dag pas rnyed pa'i rnyed don de'o/ /de la dbye na/ yul gyi don dam pa dang / yul can gyi don dam pa gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa kun rdzob bden pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong ba rdzun pas rnyed pa'i rnyed don de'o/ /de la dbye na/ yang dag kun rdzob bden pa dang /

log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis mtshan nyid ni/ kun rdzob bden pa gang zhig snang zhing snang ba ltar tha snyad du don byed nus pa de'o/ /de la dbye na/ yul gyi yang dag kun rdzob bden pa dang / yul can gyi yang dag kun rdzob bden pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus 'khrul par ma bskyed pa'i don snang gi shes pa la snang ba'i phyi rol gyi don lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phral gyi 'phrul rgyus 'khrul par ma bskyed pa'i don snang gi shes pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ kun rdzob bden pa gang zhig snang zhing snang ba ltar tha snyad du yang don byed mi nus pa de'o/ /dbye na/ yul gyi dang / yul can gyi log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes la snang ba'i zla gnyis lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ zla ba gnyis snang gi dbang shes lta bu'o/ dmigs yul bden pa bzhi la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la mtshan nyid dang bden pa bzhi bshad pa gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bden pa bzhi don dam par mi dmigs shing / tha snyad du bden pa bzhi la brten nas sgrub pa nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i ngag de'o/ /bden pa bzhi bshad pa la/ sdug bsngal bden pa/ kun 'byung bden pa/ 'gog pa'i bden pa/ lam gyi bden pa dang bzhi/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis mtshan nyid ni/ rang rgyu kun 'byung bden pa'i 'bras bu gang zhig mi rtag sdug bsngal/ stong / bdag med bzhi'i sgo nas shes byar 'phags pas gzigs pa dang mthun par gnas pa de'o/ /de la dbye na/ phyi ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang bcud kyi sems can gnyis/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal bden pa'i rgyu gang zhig rgyu/ kun 'byung / rab skye/ rkyen bzhi'i sgo nas spang byar 'phags pas gzigs pa dang mthun par gnas pa de/

kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ las kyi kun 'byung dang / nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang thob byed lam bden gyi bral 'bras gang zhig 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges 'byung bzhi'i sgo nas mngon du bya bar 'phags pas gzigs pa dang mthun par gnas pa de/ 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ lhag bcas kyi 'gog pa/ lhag med kyi 'gog pa/ rgyan bcas kyi 'gog pa/ rgyan med kyi 'gog pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'gog pa dang lngar yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi bral 'bras 'gog bden thob byed gang zhig lam/ rigs pa/ sgrub pa/ nges 'byed bzhi'i sgo nas rgyud la brten byar 'phags pas gzigs pa dang mthun par gnas pa de/ lam bden gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam dang gsum du yod/ rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ dkon mchog gsum don dam par mi dmigs shing / tha snyad du dkon mchog gsum la brten nas sgrub pa nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i ngag de'o/ /de la dbye na/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog chos dkon mchog dge 'dun dkon mchog dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ 'dus ma byas la sogs pa'i yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i chos sku de'o/ /dbye na/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku dang gsum du yod/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bsam du med pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gsum tshan gnyis po gang rung dang ldan pa'i rnam byang gi bden pa de/ chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ 'gog bden dang / lam bden gnyis su yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i don dam pa'i skyabs de/

dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ byang sems mthong lam pa dang / sgom lam pa gnyis su yod/ sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs sel byed brtson 'grus gsum la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la mtshan nyid dang / brtson 'grus gsum bshad pa gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ brtson 'grus gsum don dam par mi dmigs shing / tha snyad du brtson 'grus gsum la brten nas sgrub pa nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i ngag de'o/ de la dbye na ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus/ mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus/ lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ lus ngag gi spyod pa la ma chags pa'i sgo nas dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sgyid lug pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de'o/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ bdag nyid la brnyas shing zhum pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i dge ba la spro ba'i sems byung de'o/ /sgrub pa'i yon tan spyan dang mngon shes la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la mtshan nyid dang / spyan dang mngon shes bshad pa gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spyan dang mngon shes don dam par mi dmigs shing / tha snyad du spyan dang mngon shes la brten nas sgrub pa nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i ngag de'o/ /gnyis pa la spyan bshad pa dang / mngon shes bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ thun mong pa'i bdag rkyen pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la brten cing thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas rang yul mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can de'o/ /de la dbye na/ sha'i spyan/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lha'i spyan/ shes rab kyi spyan/ chos kyi spyan/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan dang lngar yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ thun mong ba'i bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /

thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi skyon sbyangs pa'i sha'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum gyi bar mthong ba'i yul can de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams nyid ni/ thun mong pa'i bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig dbang gzugs can pa la brten nas/ sems can thams cad kyi skye ba dang 'chi 'pho mthong ba'i yul can de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ thun mong ba'i bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas chos thams cad la cir yang mi rtog pa'i yul can de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ thun mong pa'i bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas rang dang rtogs pa mnyam pa man chad kyi 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ mthong lam gyi rjes thob nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ lnga pa la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ thun mong pa'i bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen lhag mthong khyad par can la brten nas chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i yul can de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ rjes mthun pa sa bdun pa nas yod la/ mtshan nyid pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod do/ /mngon shes la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/

bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas rang yul mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can de'o/ /de la dbye na rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes dang drug tu yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas sa g.yo ba la sogs pa byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de'o/ /yang bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i sgra chung ngu dang cig shos thos par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi skye ba dang 'chi 'pho ba la sogs pa mthong bar byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas gzhan gyi sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa sogs yod med shes par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas rang dang gzhan gyi tshe rabs snga ma du ma rjes su dran par byed nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas sgrib pa gnyis kyi sa bon spangs pa'i rnam grol lam dang bar chad med lam gang rung gi ngo bor skyes pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ drug pa zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ sa mtshams la/ mngon shes dang po lnga ni phyi rol pa la yang yod la/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes ni/ 'phags pa thams cad kyi rgyud la yod do/ /sgrub pa mthar thug pa'i rgyu mthong sgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag la mtshan nyid ni/ mthong sgom gnyis don dam par mi dmigs shing tha snyad du mthong sgom gnyis la brten nas sgrub ba nyams su longs shig ces 'doms pa'i ngag de'o/

/gnyis pa thob bya sgrub pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa la/ dngos dang / spang bya rtog pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ 'dir bstan khyad chos lngas khyad par du byas pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ theg chen sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod/ rtse mo/ /bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhir yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su ston pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyis khyad par du byas pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ 'dir bstan theg chen sbyor lam drod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ drod chung ngu / 'bring / chen po dang gsum du yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ /gzugs sogs mi gnas de dag ni/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su ston pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyis khyad par du byas pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de'o/ /de la dbye na/ rtse mo/ /chung ngu 'bring chen po dang gsum du yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med nyid/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su ston pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyis khyad par du byas pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de'o/ /dbye na/ bzod pa/ chung ngu 'bring chen po dang gsum du yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ ting 'dzin de yi byed pa nyid/ /ces sogs kyi skabs nas dngos su ston pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyis khyad par du byas pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de'o/ /dbye na/ chos mchog chung ngu 'bring / chen po dang gsum du yod do/ /gnyis pa spang bya rtog pa bshad pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo gang zhig gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la bar du gcod byed de/

'dir bstan rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ spang bya gzung rtog dang / 'dzin rtog gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spang bya rtog pa gang zhig yul gzung ba la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de'o/ /dbye na/ nyon mongs gzung rtog dang / rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spang bya gzung rtog gang zhig kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de'o/ /dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spang bya gzung rtog gang zhig rnam byang gi chos la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de/ rnam byang gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod do/ /gnyis pa 'dzin rtog la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spang bya rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de'o/ /dbye na rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / rtag 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spang bya 'dzin rtog gang zhig gang zag gi gdags gzhir gyur pa'i chos la dmigs nas rdzas yod du zhen pa'i blo de'o/ dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ spang bya 'dzin rtog gang zhig skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gyur pa'i chos la dmigs nas rtag yod du zhen pa'i blo de rtag 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod do/ /gsum pa 'jug bya sgrub pa'i yan lag gi chos bshad pa la/ sgrub pa'i rten/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo dang bzhi ru yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi rten chos theg chen sgrub pa'i rten gzhir gyur pa de'o/ /dbye na gnas skabs kyi rten dang /

mthar thug gi rten gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po byang chub sems dpa' lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sgrub pa po byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba lta bu la byed/ de la rten chos kyi sgo nas dbye na/ rten chos sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi dbye bas bcu gsum du yod/ rten chos sgrub pa bcu gsum ni/ rtogs pa'i chos drug gi sgrub pa/ gnyen po'i sgrub pa/ spong ba'i sgrub pa/ de dag yongs su gtugs pa'i sgrub pa/ shes rab snying brtser bcas pa'i sgrub pa/ slob ma dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub pa/ gzhan don go rims su byed pa'i sgrub pa/ ye shes stsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang bcu gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor bzhi/ mthong lam sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam dang drug la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sa brgyad pa'i gnas skabs kyi bar chad med lam la byed/ gsum pa ni/ sa brgyad pa'i gnas skabs kyi nyon sgrib las grol ba'i rnam grol lam la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ sa brgyad pa'i gnas skabs kyi shes sgrib las grol ba'i rnam grol lam la byed/ lnga pa ni/ sa dgu pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes la byed/ drug pa ni/ sa dgu pa'i khyad par gyi lam la byed/ bdun pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i khyad par gyi lam la byed/ brgyad pa ni/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes la byed do/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sgrub pas sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhir dmigs pa de'o/ /dbye na/ dmigs pa rnam pa bcu gcig tu yod/ de bsdu na/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan dang gsum du 'dus/ dang po dge ba la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis blang bar bya ba de'o/ /dbye na/ don dam pa'i dge ba/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba/ mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba/ kun slong gi dge ba dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ dad sogs dge ba bcu gcig lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ dad sogs dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung rnams la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ des kun nas slong ba'i lus ngag gi las lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa mi dge ba la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ lung du bstan pa gang zhig skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dor bar bya ba de'o/ /dbye na/ don dam pa'i mi dge ba/ ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba/ mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba/ kun slong gi mi dge ba dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba spyi la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi 'jig mthar gnyis ma gtogs pa'i rtsa nyon dang nye nyon rnams la byed/ gsum pa ni/ de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung rnams la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ de dag gis kun nas slob ba'i lus ngag gi las la byed do/ /gsum pa lung ma bstan la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ dge mi dge gang du yang lung du ma bstan pa'i chos so/ /dbye na/ don dam pa'i lung ma bstan sogs bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi 'jig mthar gnyis dang / khams gong ma gnyis kyi rtsa nyon dang nye nyon rnams la byed/ gsum pa ni/ de dag dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung rnams la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ des kun nas slong ba'i lus ngag gi las la byed do/ /gsum pa sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa po byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang du byas nas sgrub pa byed pa'i thob bya mthar thug de'o/ /dbye na/ sems chen po/ /spong ba chen po/ rtogs pa chen po dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ rang rgyud la ldan pa'i gang zag de dag sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du byed pa'i byed chos so/

/mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sems/ mi bsgul ba'i sems/ rlabs po che'i sems/ phan bde'i sems/ chos la kun dga' ba'i sems dang lnga la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa'i spangs pa de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i spangs pa'i yon tan lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ rten theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas 'bras bu byang chub chen po'i ched du rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po rtsom pa'i bya ba de/ theg chen sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ mkhyen gsum spyi'i sgrub pa dang / sbyor bzhi bye brag gi sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ yul skye med gsum la nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i ldog cha nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ bshad bya mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi ldog cha nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ yul can pha rol tu phyin pa la nyams len gtso bor gyur pa'i ldog cha nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ 'chad byed don bdun cu'i ldog cha nas bstan pa'i sgrub pa lta bu'o/ /de la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ go cha'i sgrub pa/ 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ tshogs kyi bsgrub pa/ nges 'byung gi sgrub pa dang bzhir yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams zhar byung phar phyin drug gi rnam par bzhag pa dang bzhir yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba de'o/ /sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan ni/ sgrub pa'i rten/ dmigs pa/ ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo dang bzhi la byed do/

/de la dbye na/ sbyin pa'i go sgrub nas/ shes rab kyi go sgrub kyi bar drug tu yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig sbyor ba rnams mkhyen yid byed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin de phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa la go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba de'o/ /lhag ma rnams la yang des 'gre'o/ sa mtshams ni/ theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod/ zhar la phar phyin drug gi rnam par bzhag pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ srid zhi gnyis kyi pha rol du phyin zin pa'am phyin byed gang rung du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs drug tu yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtong pa'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan de'o/ /chos bzhi ni/ sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang bral ba/ grogs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ 'bras bu gzhan gyi 'dod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa/ byed las theg pa gsum gyi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa dang bzhi la byed de/ de skad du yang mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs nyams dang / /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs rdzogs byed/ /sems can rnam smin byed rnam gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la dbye na/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang gsum du yod/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ 'chal tshul gyi gnyen por gyur pa'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan de'o/ dbye na/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum du yod/ rgyud mi 'khrugs pa'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan de/

bzod pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sdug bsngal dang lan gyi bzod pa/ chos la nges par rtog pa'i bzod pa/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dang gsum du yod/ /dge ba la spro ba'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan de/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ go cha'i brtson 'grus/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum du yod/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos bzhi ldan de/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan/ rtog med dpyod tsam gyi bsam gtan/ rtog med dpyod med kyi bsam gtan dang gsum du yod/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo chos bzhi ldan de/ shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab/ bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab/ bsgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab dang gsum du yod do/ /gnyis pa 'jug sgrub la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig 'jug yul theg chen la 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa'i bya ba de'o/ /dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod/ /yul dgu ni/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med gnyis/ sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug mthong ba la sogs pa'i lam/ byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi/ mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa/ 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa/ ched du bya ba/ mngon par shes pa drug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang dgu la byed/ sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas sa bcu'i bar na yod do/ /gsum pa tshogs sgrub la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa 'tshams/ rtogs dka' pa bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig rang 'bras gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byang chen dngos su 'dzin pa'i rgyu tshogs de'o/

dbye na/ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun gyi dbye bas bcu bdun du yod/ sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ /rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa la/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong bshad pa/ gzungs bshad pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bshad pa/ sa'i tshogs bshad pa/ gnyen po'i tshogs bshad pa dang lngar yod/ dang po zhi gnas la mtshan nyid ni/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhig lus sems shin tu sbyangs ba'i bde bas khyad par du byas pa de'o/ /lhag mthong la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang rgyu zhi gnas bsgom pa las byung ba'i bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de'o/ /dbye na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong dang / mi g.yo ba'i lhag mthong gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa gzungs la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan la brten nas rang gi blos khong du chud pa'i chos mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de'o/ /dbye na/ tshigs gi gzungs/ don gyi gzungs/ sngags kyi gzungs/ bzod pa'i gzungs dang bzhir yod/ gsum pa ye shes kyi tshogs la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de'o/ /dbye na/ yul stong nyid nyi shu'i dbye bas yul can ye shes kyang nyi shur yod/ bzhi pa sa'i tshogs la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i mkhyen pa de/ sa'i tshogs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ nyan thos kyi sa/ rang rgyal gyi sa/ byang sems kyi sa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ nyan thos kyi yon tan du ma'i rten byed pa'i mkhyen pa de'o/ /dbye na/ rigs kyi sa/ brgyad pa'i sa/ mthong ba'i sa/ bsrabs pa'i sa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa/ nyan thos kyi sa dang bdun du yod/ dang po ni/

nyan thos kyi sbyor lam lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i rgyud kyi rtogs pa la byed/ gsum pa ni/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi rgyud kyi rtogs pa la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi rgyud kyi rtogs pa la byed/ lnga pa ni phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi rgyud kyi rtogs pa la byed/ drug pa ni/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi rgyud kyi rtogs pa la byed/ bdun pa ni/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa/ dgra bcom zhugs pa'i rgyud kyi rtogs pa la byed do/ /gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi sa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg pa 'bring po'i mngon rtogs de'o/ /dbye na/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam dang lngar yod/ gsum pa byang sems kyi sa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje chen po zung du 'brel ba'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon spong pa'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyu tshogs de'o/ /de la dbye na/ mthong spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang / sgom spangs gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi mthong spangs kyi sa bon spong ba'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyu tshogs de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi sgom spangs kyi sa bon spongs ba'i dngos gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyu tshogs de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen sgom lam bar chad med lam lta bu la byed do/ /bzhi pa nges 'byung sgrub pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrub pa khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig nges par 'byung sa brgyad po gang rung du gdon mi za bar 'byung ba'i bya ba de'o/

/de la dbye na/ nges par 'byung sa brgyad kyi dbye bas brgyad du yod/ sa mtshams ni/ sa bcu pa kho na na yod do/ /gnyis pa rgyu thun mong ma yin pa'i lam shes yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa la/ mtshon bya lam shes bshad pa dang / de mtshon byed kyi chos bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum du yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ lam gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab de/ lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rgyu lam shes dang 'bras bu lam shes gnyis su yod/ sa mtshams ni/ theg chen 'phags pa kho na'i rgyud la yod do/ /gnyis pa de mtshon byed kyi chos bshad pa la/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang / yan lag can gyi lam shes gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rgyu lam shes kyi khyad par byed chos kyis bsdus pa'i chos so/ /de la dbye na/ lam shes ma bskyed pa bskyed par byed pa'i yan lag dang / skyes nas gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i yan lag gnyis su yod/ dang po la lam shes gang la skye ba'i rten dang / gang gis bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ne/ gegs nga rgyal mngon gyur ba dang bral ba'i rten gyi gang zag de/ lam shes gang la skye ba'i rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa la dbye na/ mthu chen byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / nyer len gyi rgyu rigs kyis khyab pa gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa lam shes skyes nas gzhan la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i yan lag la dbye na/ rgyu lam shes kyi rang bzhin dang / byed las gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i bag la nyal gyi nyon mongs ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i ngo bo de'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len pa'i rgyu la brten nas gzhan don byed pa'i las de'o/

/mtshan gzhi ni/ sems can 'khor du ma sdud pa rnams sdud/ sdud pa rnams smin/ smin pa rnams grol bar byed pa'i las lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa de rgyu lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang / shes bya lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa gnyis su yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ nyan thos lam gyi rtogs rigs bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de'o/ /shes bya lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ dngos dang / de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su bzung bar bya ba'i phyir du byang sems 'phags pas shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes bya nyan thos kyi lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos rang rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang / byang sems rang rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya nyan thos kyi lam gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor nyan thos kyi lam gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun/

drod/ rtse mo/ /bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhi ru yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / shes bya lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa gnyis su yod/ dang po mtshan nyid ni/ rang rgyal lam gyi rtogs rigs bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ shes bya lam gyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ dngos dang / de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su bzung bar bya ba'i phyir du byang sems 'phags pas shes par bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de/ shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rang rgyal rang rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam dang / byang sems rang rgyud la yod pa'i shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bo rang rgyal lam gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu'i char gyur pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun/ drod/ rtse mo/ /bzod pa/ chos mchog dang bzhir yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor byang sems lam gyi rtogs rigs bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs shes zung 'brel gyi mkhyen pa de/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/

de la dbye na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam dang / sgom lam gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ theg chen mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug tu yod/ bcu drug ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes dang bzhi/ bden pa phyi ma gsum la yang de bzhin du sbyar bas bcu drug go /dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i steng gi chos nyid sngar ma mthong gsar mthong gi theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa gang zhig bzod pas bsdus pa de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi ngos skal gyi sdug bsngal mthong spangs rtog pa'i sa bon las dngos su grol ba'i lam de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid ni/ ye shes snga ma gnyis 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa gang zhig bzod pas bsdus pa de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes bzod kyi mtshan nyid yin/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid ni/ sdug bsngal rjes bzod la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren nus pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa gang zhig shes pas bsdus pa de/ theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ bden pa lhag ma rnams la yang des rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la dbye na/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang / byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam/ sgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de/ theg chen bsgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ kun nas zhi ba la sogs pa drug tu yod/

sa mtshams ni/ sa gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de theg chen bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam dang / zag med sgom lam gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ phyi rol don du snang ba'i yang dag min rtog dang shes rgyud gcig la lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de'o/ /dbye na/ mos pa sgom lam/ bsngo ba sgom lam/ rjes su yi rang bsgom lam dang gsum du yod/ dang po la dngos dang / phan yon bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ yum don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ mos pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rang don mos pa sgom lam/ gzhan don mos pa sgom lam/ gnyis don mos pa sgom lam dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor yum rang don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor yum gzhan don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa na yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor yum gnyis don gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ sa bcu pa kho na na yod do/ /gnyis pa mos pa'i phan yon ni/ bstod bkur bsngags gsum la byed/ bstod bkur bsngags gsum ni/

yon tan chung ngu brjod pa la bstod pa dang / 'bring brjod pa la bkur ba dang / chen po brjod pa la bsngags pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ bsngo ba bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na bsngo ba sgom lam bcu gnyis su yod/ sa mtshams ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gsum pa la/ mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la rjes su yi rang bar byed pa'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de/ rjes su yi rang bsgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ sa mtshams ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ phyi rol don du gyur pa'i yang dag min rtog dang shes rgyud gcig la lhan cig tu mi 'jug pa'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs de'o/ /de la dbye na sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam yin pa gang zhig yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i ldog cha nas bstan pa de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la dngos dang 'bras bu'i rnam dag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam yin pa gang zhig mi mthun phyogs dag par byed pa'i ldog cha nas bstan pa de/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ sa mtshams ni/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa 'bras bu'i rnam dag la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/

rang thob byed zag med bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis thob pa'i grol ba de'o/ /de la dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rnam dag rang rgyal gyi rnam dag byang sems kyi rnam dag sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba dang bzhir yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ zag med bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis rang gi ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib tsam las grol ba'i rnam grol de'o/ /dbye na/ nyan thos kyi rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu/ phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu dang bzhir yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ zag med bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis rang gi ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gzung rtog tsam las grol ba'i rnam grol de/ rang rgyal gyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na rang rgyal gyi rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu/ phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu dang bzhir yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ zag med bar chad med lam gyi stobs kyis lam gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du mthong ba la gegs byed gyi sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol de/ byang sems kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sa bcu'i rnam dag bcur yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa'i rnam grol de/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i 'gog bden dang lam bden gnyis su yod do/ /gsum pa rgyu dang rgyu min gyi rab dbye gzhi shes yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa la/ 'jug yul gzhi shes/ 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab de/

gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes/ srid zhi la gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang drug tu yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ shes rab kyis 'khor ba rang bzhin med par rtogs shing / snying rjes gzhan don byed pa'i las de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes lta bu la byed/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis zin pa'i gzhi shes de/ 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems kyi mthong lam lta bu la byed/ mtshan 'dzin dang bral ba'i byang sems kyi gzhi shes de/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems kyi sgom lam lta bu la byed/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis dang bral ba'i theg dman gyi gzhi shes de/ srid zhi la gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes lta bu la byed/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis ma zin pa'i gzhi shes de/ 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam lta bu la byed/ mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i gzhi shes de/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang / sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi sbyor ba dang / shugs bstan nyan rang gi sbyor ba gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa bsal ba'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ byang sems kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ gzugs sogs yul bcu'i dbye bas bcur yod/

sa mtshams ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la sgrub pa'i yongs su shes pa dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba de/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid ni/ rlom pa rnam bzhi bkag nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin/ rlom pa rnam pa bzhi bkag pa ni/ gzugs rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs la rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs bdag gir rlom sems su mi byed pa dang bzhi la byed do/ /gsum pa la dngos dang / zhar la skabs gsum par mi ston rgyu'i sgom lam bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la dngos bstan byang sems kyi mthong lam dang / shugs bstan nyan rang gi mthong lam gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyi dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mdo las/ sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral ba'i rnam pa can gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi bde ba mngon rtogs de/ skabs gsum par dngos su bstan pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug tu yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mdo las/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i theg dman gyi bden pa mngon rtogs de/ shugs bstan nyan rang gi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug tu yod/ zhar la skabs gsum par mi ston rgyu'i sgom lam la mtshan nyid ni/ theg dman gyi rtogs ris rtogs zin pa rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i theg dman gyi bsgom lam de'o/ /des yul mkhyen gsum yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa de song / gnyis pa nyams len sbyor ba bzhi yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa la/

dbang du byed pa rgyur 'bras bshad pa dang / brtan pa rgyu 'bras bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la rgyu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bshad pa dang / 'bras bu rtse sbyor bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la theg chen gyi sbyor ba tsam bshad pa dang / rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skye ba'i sgom rim bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la theg chen gyi sbyor ba bshad pa dang / de mtshan nyid kyis ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ sgom pa po'i gang zag bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ spyir bshad pa dang / 'dir bstan bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul gyi khyad par de/ rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ don rnam dang / shes rnam gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ shes pas khyad par du ma byas pa'i yul gyi khyad par de/ don rnam kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ gang zag gi bdag med kyi rnam pa dang / chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam pa gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang bzhin skye med kyi rnam pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ shes pas khyad par du byas pa'i yul gyi khyad par de/ shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ mi mthun phyogs kyi shes rnam dang / gnyen po'i phyogs kyi shes rnam gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra rtag 'dzin gyi log rtog lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul gyi gnas tshul dang mthun par zhugs pa'i blo de/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sgra mi rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa 'dir bstan bye brag tu bshad pa la mtshan nyid dang /

dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bden bzhi rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ 'dir bstan rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa/ lam shes kyi rnam pa/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de'o/ /de la dbye na/ bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bzhi bzhi dang / lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga ste nyer bdun du yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ lam gyi gnas tshul rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ lam shes kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa/ lam gyi bden pa'i rnam pa/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa/ 'gog pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa dang bzhi ru yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ kun 'byung bden pa spangs gnyen gyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ kun 'byung bden pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ kun 'byung bden pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam brgyad du yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ lam bden dam bca' dang 'thad pa'i sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ lam gyi bden pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ lam gyi bden pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam bdun du yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ sdug bsngal bden pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam lnga ru yod/

bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ 'gog bden glo bur dri bral gyi sgo nas bdag med gnyis ka'i rnam pa can du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ 'gog pa'i bden pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ 'gog bden gyi lam shes kyi shes rnam bcu drug tu yod do/ /gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de'o/ /dbye na/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra 'phags chung 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa de'o/ /dbye na/ nyan rang dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang / byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / zhar la byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam par bzhag pa gnyis su yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa nyan rang 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi byang phyogs so bdun lta bu la byed/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgom bya rnam pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam pa la byed do/ /zhar la byang phyogs so bdun gyi rnam par bzhag pa la/ byang phyogs so bdun ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad dang bcas pa rnams la byed do/ /dang po la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi po gang rung la rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rtogs par byed pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/

dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang bzhi ru yod/ sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ spangs gnyen la blangs dor du rtogs par byed pa'i brtson 'grus de/ yang dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ mi dge ba skyed pa spong bar byed pa'i yang dag spong ba/ ma skyes pa mi skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba/ dge ba skyed pa spel bar byed pa'i yang dag spong ba/ ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba dang bzhir yod/ /sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam 'bring nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por gyur pa'i spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i sems gnas pa las su rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ /'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ /sems pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ /brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ /dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang bzhir yod/ sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chen po nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang 'bras 'phags lam bskyed pa la bdag por gyur pa'i mkhyen pa de/ dbang po'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ dad pa'i dbang po/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po/ dran pa'i dbang po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po/ shes rab kyi dbang po dang lngar yod/ sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam drod nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/

lnga pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ ma dad pa la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i mkhyen pa de/ stobs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na dad pa'i stobs la sogs pa stobs lngar yod/ sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam bzod pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ drug pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam de/ byang chub kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos rab tu rnam 'byed yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang bdun du yod/ sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ bdun pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ sgom spangs dag par byed pa'i mkhyen pa de 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang brgyad du yod/ sa mtshams ni/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa byang sems dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa de'o/ /de la dbye na/ gnyen po'i lam/ spong ba'i lam/ mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lam/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam/ sprul pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi lam dang drug tu yod do/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/

mtshan nyid ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra 'phags chung 'og ma'i rgyud la med pa de/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ brten pa yon tan bshad pa dang / rten ye shes bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la dbye na/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang sde tshan rnam pa bzhi ru yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten nas shes bya ma lus pa mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i mkhyen pa de/ stobs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ gnas dang gnas ma yin par mkhyen pa'i stobs la sogs pa stobs bcur yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' la brten nas 'khor gyi dbus su dam bca' 'jog pa la chos mthun gyi rgol ba med cing / chos mi mthun gyis rgol mi nus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de/ mi 'jigs pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi ru yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bsam gtan gyi rab mtha' la brten nas bshad bya dang 'chad byed mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de/ so so yang dag rig pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ chos dang / don dang / spobs pa dang / nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag pa dang bzhi ru yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mdo las ma 'dres pa'i ming gis dngos su bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum/ 'phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum dang bco brgyad du yod do/ /gnyis pa rten ye shes bshad pa la/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa/

rang byung gi rnam pa/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ chos nyid ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug de/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ chos can ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug de/ rang byung gi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug de/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ des bsgom bya rnam pa bshad pa de song nas/ gnyis pa bsgom pa po'i gang zag la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ phyi nang gi mthun rkyen khyad par can gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yum len pa'i snod du gyur pa'i byang sems de/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom pa po'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yum nyan pa'i snod/ tshig 'dzin pa'i snod/ don mi brjed par sems pa'i snod/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i snod dang bzhir yod/ sa mtshams ni/ theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas/ rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /gsum pa bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ theg chen sbyor ba dngos bshad pa dang / sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus nas bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga dang / gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga ste nyi shur yod/ sa mtshams ni/ theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas/ rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos bshad pa la/ blang bar bya ba'i yon tan dang / dor bar bya ba'i skyon gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan de/
