theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhir yod/ sa mtshams ni/ theg pa chen po'i tshogs lam nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba bsgom pa la bar du gcod byed de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ skyon bzhi bcu rtsa drug tu yod/ sa mtshams ni/ sa bdun pa man chad na yod do/ /gnyis pa de mtshan nyid kyis ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sbyor ba mtshon byed dang / theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan gzhi gang rung du dmigs pa de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang / las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mongs ma yin par mtshon byed de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ khyad mtshan/ byed mtshan dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig gtso bor ma 'ongs pa na rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs kyi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig

ma 'ongs pa na gzhi skye med du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ yum de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar rtogs pa sogs sems dpa'i rnal 'byor bcu drug lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong ma yin par mtshon byed gang zhig ma 'ongs pa na lam skye med du rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rnam thar sgo gsum sogs lam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor bcu drug lta bu la byed/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig ma 'ongs pa na rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byes pa'i theg chen rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa yum la rim gro mdzad pa sogs rnam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor bcu drug lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig theg chen gyi sbyor ba de theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags par byed pa'i byed chos so/ /de la dbye na/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen lam shes sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan dang / rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i khyad mtshan gnyis su yod/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs ris su gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor bcu drug lta bu la byed do/

/gsum pa byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig gtso bor ma 'ongs pa na gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs kyi lag rjes 'jog byed de'o/ /de la dbye na/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed mtshan/ lam shes sbyor ba'i byed mtshan/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gzhishes sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig gtso bor ma 'ongs pa na phan bde skyob gsum gyi mdzad pa nye bar sgrub pa'i rtogs ris su gyur pa de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas pa na phan bde skyob gsum gyi mdzad pa nye bar sgrub pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen lam shes sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig gtso bor ma 'ongs pa na skyabs sogs bdun gyi mdzad pa nye bar sgrub pa'i rtogs ris su gyur pa de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen lam shes sbyor ba'i byed mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas pa na skyabs sogs bdun gyi mdzad pa nye bar sgrub pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor lta bu la byed/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen rnam mkhyen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon byed gang zhig gtso bor ma 'ongs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bdag rkyen nye bar sgrub pa'i rtogs ris su gyur pa de/ byed sgrub kyi dbang du byed pa'i theg chen rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas pa na chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bdag rkyen nye bar sgrub par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor lta bu la byed do/

/gnyis pa las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ shes khyad byed pa gsum gyis theg chen sbyor ba'i tha snyad gang la mtshon par bya ba'i gzhir dmigs pa de'o/ /de la dbye na/ las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ lam shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes byed gnyis kyis tha snyad gang la mtshon par bya ba'i gzhir dmigs pa de'o/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ nyon mongs kyis dben pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen lam shes sbyor ba'i shes khyad byed pa gsum gyis tha snyad gang la mtshon par bya ba'i gzhir dmigs pa de/ las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen lam shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bya dka' ba'i ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba lta bu la byed/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ theg chen rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes khyad byed pa gsum gyis tha snyad gang la mtshon par bya ba'i gzhir dmigs pa de/ las sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i theg chen rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sbyor ba lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pa'i sgom rim la dbye na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam sku gsum so sor ma phye ba'i rgyur bsgom pa'i tshul dang / sbyor ba khyad par can sku gsum 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i rgyur bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis su yod/ dang po la dbye na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam bshad pa dang / rten gyi gang zag phyir mi ldog pa'i phan yon gyi sgo nas bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ skye med gsum gyi rnam pa la dbang ma thob pa thob pa'i phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/

skabs bzhi pa'i bstan bya rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na tshogs lam gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang / sbyor lam gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ gnyis su yod/ dang po la ni thar pa cha mthun zhes bya la/ de la mtshan nyid ni/ shes rab kyis chos thams cad bden pa'i rang bzhin med par rtogs shing / thabs kyis sbyin sogs kyi dge ba rang rgyud la bskyed mkhas pa'i theg chen las dang po pa'i mngon rtogs de/ 'dir bstan thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid yin/ gnyis pa la ni nges 'byed cha mthun zhes bya la/ de la mtshan nyid ni/ rjes thob gtso bor gyur pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun de/ 'dir bstan nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ drod kyi nges 'byed cha mthun/ rtse mo'i nges 'byed cha mthun/ bzod pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun/ chos mchog gi nges 'byed cha mthun dang bzhir yod do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags bshad pa gnyis su yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba rgyud la skyes pas gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyal sras de phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems/ sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ byang sems sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshul gsum tshang ba de/ byang sems sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de ni dper na ma nges pa'i rigs can gyi byang sems sbyor lam pa chos can/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa yin te/ gzugs sogs la mngon zhen zlog pa'i rjes thob kyi spyod pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes pa dang / yang de chos can/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa yin te rjes thob tu gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba yang tshol ba'i phyir/

zhes pa ni 'bras bu'i rtags so/ /yang de chos can/ bye brag gzhan gyis bar ma chod par sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rang rgyud la 'byung du rung ba yin te/ de 'byung ba'i rgyu tshogs grangs tshang ba'i phyir/ zhes pa ni rang bzhin gyi rtags so/ /gnyis pa la dbye na/ chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/ gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ 'phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor chos sku'i ched du srid zhi rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/ sa mtshams ni/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba tsam ni theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas yod la/ sa brgyad pa nas mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor gzugs sku'i ched du phyin drug nyams su len pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ rang nyid gang du sangs rgya ba'i snod kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang / bcud kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba gnyis su yod/ sa mtshams la/ zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba tsam ni theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas yod/ sbyor ba khyad par can ni/ sa dgu pa na yod do/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid dbye ba/ zhar la bdud bzhi bcom pa'i sa mtshams bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ gtso bor gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs kyi ched du stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i yul bcu mngon sum du byed pa'i dus dang dus min pa shes par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ 'phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ dgra las 'das pa la sogs pa thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba bcur yod/ zhar la bdud bzhi bcom pa'i sa mtshams bshad pa la/ bdud bzhi'i mtshan nyid dang bcom pa'i sa mtshams dngos bshad pa gnyis su yod/

mtshan nyid ni/ nyer len gyi phung po de/ phung po'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid yin/ las nyon gyi dbang gis rang dbang med par 'chi ba'i ngor skyes pa de/ 'chi bdag gi bdud kyi mtshan nyid yin/ nyon mongs pa dang des kun nas slong ba'i las gang rung de/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid yin/ bdud gzhan gsum las 'da' ba'i phyir du brtson 'grus rtsom pa la bar du gcod byed de/ lha'i bu'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid yin/ lha'i bu'i bdud kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa chung ma dang bcas pas 'dod pa khams pa'i sems can rnams la me tog gi mda' rnam pa lnga 'phangs pa'i las la bshad kyang / don la ni/ brgyal bar byed pa/ rmongs par byed pa/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa/ rnam 'tshe dang / phrag dog ser sna dang lnga la ni/ 'dod pa'i mda' lnga zhes bya la/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang rnam 'tshe gnyis la ni/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa chung ma dang bcas pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa bcom pa'i sa mtshams dngos bshad pa ni/ dman pa'i lhag med myang 'das kyi tshe bdud bzhi ma lus par bcom pa yin la/ theg chen gyis ni sa dang po nas bdud bzhi ma lus par bcom ba yin zhing / bdud bzhi'i gnas ngan len bcom pa dang / sangs rgyas thob par dus mnyam pa yin no/ /gnyis pa skye med gsum gyi rnam pa la dbang thob pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa'i rtse mo'i sbyor ba bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ 'dir rab tu gyur pa'i don ni/ mi mthun phyogs kyi spong gnyen du gyur pa la byed do/ /dbye na/ so so skye bo'i rtse sbyor dang / 'phags pa'i rtse sbyor gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ so so skye bo'i rgyud kyi mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/

/dbye na/ rtags kyi rtse sbyor/ rnam 'phel gyi rtse sbyor/ nges par brtan pa'i rtse sbyor/ sems kun tu gnas pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhir yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mdo las rtags bcu gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/ /de ni drod kyi rtse sbyor dang don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod kyi mnyam gzhag ye shes lta bu la byed/ dbye na rmi lam gyi rtags drug dang / sad pa'i rtags drug ste bcu gnyis su yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ mdo las rnam 'phel bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ rnam 'phel rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de ni rtse mo'i rtse sbyor dang don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam rtse mo'i mnyam gzhag ye shes lta bu la byed/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ mdo las brtan pa gnyis kyis dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ nges par brtan pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de ni bzod pa'i rtse sbyor dang don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam bzod pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes lta bu la byed/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid ni/ mdo las rjes su yi rang bas dngos su mtshon nas bstan pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ sems kun tu gnas pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de ni chos mchog gi rtse sbyor dang don gcig mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos mchog gi mnyam gzhag ye shes lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa 'phags pa'i rtse sbyor la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/

/dbye na/ mthong lam rtse sbyor/ sgom lam rtse sbyor/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang gsum du yod/ dang po la/ spang bya rtog pa bshad pa dang / mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo gang zhig sgom spangs min par gyur pa'i rtog pa kun btags de/ 'dir bstan mthong spangs rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ mthong spangs gzung rtog dang / 'dzin rtog gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs rtog pa gang zhig yul gzung ba la dmigs nas gzung bar zhen pa'i blo de'o/ /dbye na/ 'jug pa gzung rtog dang / ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs gzung rtog gang zhig theg chen gyi chos la dmigs nas 'jug byar zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spangs 'jug pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs gzung rtog gang zhig theg dman gyi chos la dmigs nas ldog byar zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spangs ldog pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod do/ /gnyis pa mthong spangs 'dzin rtog la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs rtog pa gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de'o/ /dbye na/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / rtag 'dzin rtog pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de'o/ /dbye na/ gang zag la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / chos la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/

mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gang zhig gang zag gi gdags gzhir gyur pa'i phung po la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i gang zag la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gang zhig skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gyur pa'i chos la dmigs nas rdzas yod kyi 'dzin par zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i chos la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gang zhig yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas btags pa tsam du zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i skyes bu'i btags 'dzin rtog pa dang / chos la btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gang zhig yul skyes bu la dmigs nas btags pa tsam du zhen pa'i blo de'o/ /dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong spangs 'dzin rtog gang zhig skyes bu'i gdags gzhir gyur pa'i chos la dmigs nas btags pa tsam du zhen pa'i blo de/ mthong spangs su gyur pa'i chos la btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ yul dgu'i dbye bas dgur yod do/ /gnyis pa mthong lam rtse sbyor la dbye na/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya spangs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i nyer len can gyi 'bras bu bshad pa dang / nyer len gyi rgyu mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la byang chub chen po'i lhan cig byed rkyen bshad pa dang / byang chub chen po dngos bshad pa gnyis/

dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi nyer len gyi 'bras bu byang chub chen po'i rgyu'i nus pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa'i rkyen de'o/ /dbye na/ gzhan 'bras bu rtogs pa'i chos la 'god pa/ rgyu lung gi chos la 'god pa/ rang nyid byang chub kyi rgyu la sbyor ba dang gsum du yod/ gnyis pa la dngos dang / zhar la rnal 'byor gyi sa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la byang chen tsam dang / 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i byang chen gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub de/ byang chen tsam gyi mtshan nyid ni/ de la dbye na/ sku gsum du yod de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gi byang chub che/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dri ma zad skye bden pa par mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i ye shes de/ 'dir bstan byang chen gyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byar de/ rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/ gzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/ 'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa/ spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa dang bzhir yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ skye 'jig can gyi rtags las phung po bden med du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor de'o/ /sa mtshams ni/ tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ lhag cig dmigs nges kyi rtags las gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong par rtogs nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor de/ gzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid yin/ sa mtshams ni/ sbyor lam drod nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ gzung ba med pa'i rtags las 'dzin pa bden med du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor de/

'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid yin/ sa mtshams ni/ sbyor lam bzod pa nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid ni/ rten 'brel gyi rtags las gnyis med kyi ye shes bden med du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ /spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid yin/ ma mtshams ni/ spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa tsam ni byang sems kyi sbyor lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar na yod la/ khyad par can ni/ sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa la bar chad med dang khyad par gyi lam gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi mthong spangs rtog pa'i sa bon la dngos su gnod pa byed pa de/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la dngos btags ma phye ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ sbyor ba nyer bsdogs dang 'jug pa bar chad med gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi mthong spangs rtogs pa'i sa bon drung nas 'byin par mi nus shing / mgo gnon par nus pa de/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i ye shes lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi mthong spangs rtog ba'i sa bon drung nas 'byin par nus pa de mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod/ kun 'byung chos bzod/ 'gog pa chos bzod/ lam chos bzod dang bzhir yod/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi lam la/

mnyam gzhag seng ge rnam bsgyings dang / rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog tshul gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid ni/ mthong lam gyi khyad par gyi lam la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug de'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ mthong lam rjes thob la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs zlog tu rtog par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/ /gnyis pa bsgom lam rtse sbyor la/ bsgom lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya ji ltar spong ba'i tshul dang / de spangs pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i brten pa yon tan bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la/ sgom lam rtse sbyor bshad pa dang / spang bya rtog pa bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi sgom spangs rtog pa'i sa bon la dngos su gnod pa byed pa de'o/ /dbye na/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings dang / dngos gzhi thod rgal gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi sgom spangs rtog pa'i sa bon drung 'byin mi nus shing mgo gnon pa'i mkhyen pa de'o/ /dbye na/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings chung ngu'i chung du sogs dgur yod/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi sgom spangs rtog pa'i sa bon drung 'byin par nus pa de/ dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ theg chen gyi dngos gzhi thod rgal chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs dgur yod do/ /gnyis pa bsgom spangs rtog pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ yul gyi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i blo gang zhig

mthong lam gyis drung 'byin par mi nus pa'i rtog pa de/ sgom spangs rtog pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sgom spangs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi ru yod/ de re re la yang yul gyi dbye bas dgu dgur yod/ de yang khams gsum gyi dbye bas brgya rtsa brgyad du yod do/ /gnyis pa brten pa yon tan la mtshan nyid dang sa mtshams gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ theg pa gsum gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i 'gal rkyen mngon 'gyur ba zad cing / mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa de/ brten pa yon tan gyi mtshan nyid yin/ sa mtshams ni/ rgyun mtha' nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dmigs rnam bshad pa gnyis su yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus bsgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gang zhig rnam mkhyen skad cig ma dang po'i dngos rgyur gyur pa de/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgyun mtha'i ting nge 'dzin la byed do/ /dmigs rnam la dngos dang / bsal bya log sgrub bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gzhir dmigs pa de/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ bden stong sgyu ma lta bu la byed/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor rang dbang du skyed byed de/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi bdag rkyen gyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgyun mtha' man chad kyi skye med gsum gyi dmigs rnam mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i dran pa lta bu la byed/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyis yul la dmigs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi bye brag de/ de'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyun mtha'i ye shes lta bu la byed/ zhar la de ma thag rkyen ni rigs pa snga ma la byed do/

/gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ bden gnyis gang rung re re rgyu mtshan du byas nas cig shos sun 'byin pa'i log rtog gam rtsod ngag gang rung de dmigs rnam la log sgrub kyis rtsod pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ log rtog dang / rtsod ngag gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyis sel/ gnyis pa ni/ de la brten pa'i lan gyis sel bar byed do/ /rtsod pa'i tshul ni/ don dam rtags su bkod nas kun rdzob sun 'byin pa dang / kun rdzob rtags su bkod nas don dam sun 'byin pa dang / kun rdzob nyid rtags su bkod nas don dam nyid sun 'byin pa dang / don dam nyid rtags su bkod nas kun rdzob nyid sun 'byin pa dang bzhir yod/ dang po la kun rdzob kyi sgo nas lan 'debs/ gnyis pa la don dam gyi sgo nas lan 'debs/ phyi ma gnyis la ni/ kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis ka'i sgo nas lan 'debs par byed do/ /des dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras bshad pa de song / gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras bshad pa la/ skye med gsum gyi rnam pa la brtan pa ma thob pa thob phyir du bsgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang / brtan pa thob nas/ cig car du bsgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bshad pa gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum/ mtshan nyid ni/ skye med gsum gyi rnam pa la brtan pa ma thob pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na phar phyin drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dang phar phyin drug zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la brtan pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/

/dbye na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba nas/ shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i bar drug tu yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dang / sbyin pa'i phar phyin zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la brtan pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/ /dbye na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mthar gyis bya ba/ mthar gyis bslab pa/ mthar gyis sgrub pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ sbyor lam gyi gnas skabs kyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ mthong lam gyi gnas skabs kyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la byed/ gsum pa ni/ sgom lam gyi gnas skabs kyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la byed do/ /des lhag ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dang rjes dran drug zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la brtan pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ chos rjes su dran pa'i/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i/ lha rjes su dran pa'i/ tshul khrims rjes su dran pa'i/ gtong ba rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang drug tu yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dang sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa zung 'brel du nyams su len pa la brtan pa thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/ /dbye na/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis bya ba/ mthar gyis bslab pa/ mthar gyis sgrub pa dang gsum du yod/ des lhag ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ chos thams cad bden pa'i ngo bo nyid med par rtogs nas bsgom pa la dbang thob phyir du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/

dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs nas bsgom pa'i mthar gyis bya ba/ mthar gyis bslab pa/ mthar gyis sgrub pa dang gsum du yod do/ /gsum pa sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod kyi rjes thob nas/ sa bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la mtshan nyid dbye ba sa mtshams dang gsum du yod/ mtshan nyid ni/ skye med gsum gyi rnam pa la brtan pa thob nas cig car du bsgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de'o/ /dbye na/ rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ rnam par smin pa min pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhir yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ blo skad cig ma gcig gis rnam par smin pa'i chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ dus skad cig ma gcig la rnam par smin pa'i chos thams cad mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ blo skad cig ma gcig gis rnam par smin pa'i chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ dus skad cig ma gcig la rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i chos thams cad mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/ rnam par smin pa min pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ 'dir rnam par smin ma smin gyi khyad par ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sbyin pa nas dpe byad kyi bar gyi zag med kyi chos thams cad la ni rnam par smin pa zhes bya la/ dag pa sa gsum gyi gnas skabs kyi sbyin pa dang / dpe byad kyi bar gyi zag med kyi chos rnams la ni rnam par smin pa min pa zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa la mtshan nyid ni/ blo skad cig ma gcig gis dus skad cig ma gcig la chos thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis med du shes pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/

gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ bzhi pa la mtshan nyid ni/ blo skad cig ma gcig gis dus skad cig ma gcig la chos thams cad bden pa'i mtshan nyid med par shes pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug de/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ gsum pa sa mtshams ni/ sa bcu pa kho na na yod do/ des sbyor bzhi yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa de song nas/ gsum pa chos sku yan lag dang bcas te bshad pa la/ rten sku bshad pa/ brten pa ye shes bshad pa/ mdzad pa 'phrin las bshad pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ sbyor bzhi bsgom pa'i rnam smin mthar thug de/ 'bras bu chos sku'i mtshan nyid yin/ de la dbye na/ sku gnyis su dbye ba/ gsum du dbye ba/ bzhir dbye ba/ lngar dbye ba dang bzhir yod/ dang po la/ rang don don dam pa'i sku dang / gzhan don kun rdzob pa'i sku gnyis su yod/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ longs sprul gnyis lta bu la byed do/ /de skad du yang / rgyud bla ma las/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la rang don gyi sku/ gzhan don gyi sku/ de gnyis kyi rten byed pa'i sku dang gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku lta bu la byed/ gsum pa ni/ chos kyi sku lta bu la byed de/ /de skad du yang / mdo sde rgyan las/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes par bya/ /sku gsum dag gis rang gzhan gyi /don 'di brten dang bcas par bstan/ /zhes gsungs ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ rtogs pa ye shes chos kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku dang bzhir yod/

dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i rang don gyi sku de/ ngo bo nyid sku'i mtshan nyid yin te/ de skad du yang / rgyud bla ma las/ de la sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /ngo bo nyid sku mtshan nyid lnga/ /mdor na yon tan lnga dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du rig par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /mtshan nyid lnga ni/ 'dus ma byas pa/ yon tan gyi chos rnams dang dbyer med pa/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa/ sgrib pa ma lus par spangs pa/ 'od gsal ba dang lnga la byed de/ ji skad du/ rgyud bla ma las/ /'dus ma byas shing rnam dbyer med/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni rnam par spangs/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum las ni nges grol te/ /dri med rnam par rtog med dang / /rnal 'byor rnams kyi yul yin phyir/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid kyis ni/ /dag pa'i phyir na 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yon tan lnga ni/ gzhal du med pa'i yon tan/ grangs med pa'i yon tan/ bsam du med pa'i yon tan/ mnyam du med pa'i yon tan/ dag pa'i yon tan dang lnga la byed de/ de skad du yang / rgyud bla ma las/ gzhal med grangs med bsam med dang / /mnyam med dag pa'i mthar thug pa'i/ /yon tan rnams dang yang dag par/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku ldan de/ /rgya che'i phyir dang grangs med phyir/ /rtog ge'i yul ni min phyir dang / /'ba' zhig bag chags bcas spangs phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ gnas gyur mthar thug gi ye shes yin pa gang zhig gzugs sku gnyis kyi bdag rkyen du dmigs pa de/ rtogs ye chos sku'i mtshan nyid yin/ gsum pa la dbye na/ snang tshul gyi longs sku dang / gnas tshul gyi longs sku gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar thug de/ snang tshul gyi longs sku'i mtshan nyid yin/ nges pa lnga ni/ gnas nges pa 'og min stug po bkod pa lta bur bzhugs pa/

'khor nges pa byang sems 'phags pa sha stag gis bskor ba/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bzhugs pa/ ngo bo nges pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ chos nges pa theg pa chen po'i chos 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pa dang lnga la byed/ mtshan gzhi ni/ byang sems 'phags pa'i mig shes la longs skur snang ba'i longs sku lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ khyad par lnga dang ldan pa'i gzhan don gyi sku de/ gnas tshul gyi longs sku'i mtshan nyid yin/ khyad par lnga ni/ gsung brjod pa rgyun mi chad pa/ sku ston pa rgyun mi chad pa/ mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi chad pa/ sna tshogs su snang yang sna tshogs kyi ngo bor ma grub pa/ de dag la kun tu rtog pa'i mngon par 'du byed med pa dang lnga la byed de/ rgyud bla ma las/ brjod ston mdzad rgyun mi chad dang / /mngon par 'du byed med pa dang / de yi ngo bo mi ston la/ /'dir ni sna tshogs rnam lngar brjod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i longs sku lta bu la byed do/ /bzhi pa la dbye na/ snang tshul gyi sprul sku dang / gnas tshul gyi sprul sku gnyis su yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i gzugs sku mthar thug de/ snang tshul gyi sprul sku'i mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i ston pa shākya thub pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i gzhan don gyi sku de/ gnas tshul gyi sprul sku'i mtshan nyid yin/ khyad par bzhi ni/ gdul bya thar pa'i lam la 'god pa/ theg chen du smin pa/ byang chub tu lung ston pa/ longs sku'i rgyu las byung ba dang bzhi la byed de/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'jig rten zhi ba'i lam la 'jug pa dang / /rab tu smin dang lung ston rgyu yi gzugs/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sprul sku lta bu la byed do/ /gnyis pa brten pa ye shes bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ gnas gyur mthar thug gi ye shes de/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi mtshan nyid yin/ dbye na/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang lnga ru yod do/ /gsum pa mdzad pa 'phrin las bshad pa la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ mtshan nyid ni/ rang rgyu chos skus bdag rkyen byas pa las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi dge ba de/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid yin/ de la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ byed pa po la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dang / bya ba yul la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las gnyis su yod/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na/ lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dang / rgyun mi chad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las gnyis su yod/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye na/ gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa/ lam la 'god pa/ lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa dang gsum du yod/ dang po la mtshan nyid ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam dkar gyi dge ba de/ byed pa po la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i longs sprul gnyis lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid ni/ slob pa'i sas bsdus pa'i rnam dkar gyi dge ba de/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid yin/ mtshan gzhi ni/ snang tshul gyi longs sprul gnyis lta bu la byed do/ /gsum pa gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa la mtshan nyid ni/ ye shes chos sku'i bdag rkyen la brten nas gdul bya ngan 'gro nas bde 'gro'i rten la 'god pa'i bya ba de/ gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyi mtshan nyid yin/
